# hg server

**What this page tells you:** every `hg server` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Destination server lifecycle: preflight, bootstrap, register, destroy.

## Synopsis

```text
hg server preflight [flags]
hg server bootstrap [flags]
hg server register [flags]
hg server destroy [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## `hg server preflight`

```text
hg server preflight [flags]
```

Srv00x readiness findings for a destination server.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--host` | `<user@host>` | — | The server, over SSH. |
| `--home` | `<sync-root>` | `/mnt/ssd/hermes-gitops` | The sync-root on the server. |
| `--allow-local-state` | — | — | Permit local (non-sink) Pulumi state. |

## `hg server bootstrap`

```text
hg server bootstrap [flags]
```

Pinned k3s + kubectl/helm/bun (checksummed, from versions.json), sync-root layout, server identity — idempotent.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--host` | `<user@host>` | — | The server, over SSH. |
| `--home` | `<sync-root>` | — | The sync-root on the server. |

## `hg server register`

```text
hg server register [flags]
```

Register the environment with its operations channel (idempotent — never duplicates the permanent message).

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--channel` | `<slack-channel-id>` | — | The operations channel. |
| `--environment` | `<name>` | — | The environment name registered. |

## `hg server destroy`

```text
hg server destroy [flags]
```

Harness hg-scoped destruction: timers, k3s, sync-root entries, kubeconfig — nothing else.

Gated on the sink saying the named backup is RESTORABLE (read with the reader identity); refuses without `--nuclear`; DSTR001–006 verify the result.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--host` | `<user@host>` | — | The server, over SSH. |
| `--backup` | `<backup-id>` | — | The backup that must be RESTORABLE before anything is destroyed. |
| `--sink` | `gs://...` | — | The sink holding that backup. |
| `--nuclear` | — | — | Required. There is no non-nuclear destroy. |
